attchmntText: Maral Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication for un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026

Maral Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange about In-principle approval of capital expenditure plan of up to Rs. 180 crore. The proposed capex plan is intended for upgradation, modernisation and capacity enhancement at the Company s Sarovar Plant, encompassing the Spinning, Fabric Printing and Engineering Divisions, including conversion of existing unit into mélange unit. The implementation of the capex plan is envisaged till the year 2030, subject to detailed project planning, availability of funds, and other relevant commercial and operational considerations. Refer point 2 of disclosure read with annexure b

Maral Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 27, 2026.in continuation to disclosure made on 7th May 2026 and 30th July 2026 regarding acquisition of 26% equity stake in Asawata Energy Private Limited for an amount of Rs. 2.60 lakh, for setting up 15 MW Solar Power Plant at Sarovar Plant of the Company, under Group Captive Model of the Madhya Pradesh Electricity Regulatory Commission (Verification of Captive Generating Plants and Captive Users) Regulations, 2023, after negotiation due to change in circumstances, the Board has approved the investment amount of Rs.3.64 Crores instead of Rs.2.60 lakh. Refer point no.3 of disclosure read with annexure C

Maral Overseas Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026 along with in principle approval of capex plan and update on acquisition in Asawata Energy Private Limited
Maral Overseas Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Report on re-lodgment of Transfer Requests of Physical Shares under Special Window'.
